name: CO2-avgift on mineral oil
law: Stortingets vedtak om CO2-avgift på mineralske produkter (under særavgiftsloven): the CO2-avgift on road diesel (autodiesel), temporarily reduced by regulation to kr 3.09 per litre from 2026-05-01 to 2026-08-31 (the generell sats on mineral oil: kr 4.42), as the Ministry of Finance's tables and press release give it. The importer or producer pays it and passes it on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).
